item.title: [Lanka Talks] Agentic coding is now multiplayer: Introducing Slack Code
item.description: Slack has introduced Slack Code, a new way for teams to collaborate with AI agents on software development directly within Slack. As coding agents transform how individuals build software, Slack Code brings development out of private tabs and into a shared workspace where teams and agents can write, review, and ship code together in the open.
